prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 50s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy cherry-red PVC catsuit with long sleeves and matching PVC gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless cherry-red PVC hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the PVC: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. She holds a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball low in front of her hips in both hands, her arms hanging straight down and pulled long by its weight. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her shoulders drooping, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet close together flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Wear: The suit is dulled with dust and soot smears down her arms and legs, rust-brown streaks run from the iron at her ankles, sweat shines on the polish across her shoulders and thighs, and the gloves are streaked black. Faint soot smudges circle the openings around her eyes, her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy cherry-red PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy PVC hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a hint of quiet misery, her brows tilted up slightly at the inner ends and her lips pressed together, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
